title: Two months of salary unpaid
user_input: I work as a customer support executive at BrightPath Services Pvt Ltd in Noida. My monthly salary is ₹32,000 and it is credited to my bank account by the 7th of each month. I have not received my salary for August 2025 and September 2025, so ₹64,000 is pending. I emailed HR (Ms. Kavita Rao) on 10 September and again on 8 October 2025. HR replied once saying 'cash flow issues, will be cleared soon' but nothing has been paid. I am still working there. I have my offer letter, salary slips up to July, and bank statements.

data.issue_overview: [Demo mode – template guidance, not AI] This appears to be a claim for unpaid salary. Employers generally must pay earned wages on time; the exact process depends on your employment terms and your state's labour authorities.
assumptions: The demo engine uses templates and cannot assess the specific facts.

laws_referenced.name: Code on Wages, 2019
laws_referenced.relevance: Brought into force from 21 November 2025 with the other three labour codes. It replaced the Payment of Wages Act, 1936, the Minimum Wages Act, 1948, the Payment of Bonus Act, 1965 and the Equal Remuneration Act, 1976. Some rules (central and state) may still be pending – verify current status.

data.title: Request for Payment of Pending Salary (demo template)
data.subject: Request for payment of pending salary – ₹32,000
data.body:
Dear [HR Manager / Employer name],

I have been working as [designation] since [joining date]. My salary for [month 1] and [month 2] has not been paid, amounting to ₹32,000. I have raised this on [dates] but have not received payment.

I request you to pay the pending amount within 15 days of this letter and to confirm the payment date in writing.

I have attached copies of the supporting documents.

Yours sincerely,
[Your name]
[Phone] | [Email]
